title: Selepet language
text: Selepet is a Trans-New Guinea language spoken by approximately 7,000 people in Morobe Province, Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Finisterre-Huon branch of this family and is primarily used in the Selepet Rural LLG area along the Huon Peninsula.
